Use DeepSeek for generation/planning and Ollama qwen3-embedding:0.6b for vector embeddings; do not switch generation to Ollama. Required raw evidence: provider split redacted config showing DeepSeek generation/planning and Ollama/Qwen embedding; job HTTP/JSON records and process events for each stage; DB SQL/JSON snapshots before/after for knowledge_entries, recipe_source_refs, semantic_memories, coverage_ledger, deep_mining_rounds, lifecycle/proposal/event tables as relevant; retained job logs if failure occurs.
